observation: The mutation-smoke gate failed because pytest in the isolated temporary campaign root did not load tests/conftest.py when the sentinel test path was passed as an absolute argument: with no config file at the campaign root, pytest sets rootdir to the test file's own directory and never ascends to load the parent tests/conftest.py, so the session-scoped `root` fixture used by test_kills_contract_validity_mutant was reported as not found (infrastructure-error for all mutants).
evidence: scripts/mutation_smoke.py; tests/conftest.py (def root); harness.sh; reproduced by copying src/tests/benchmark into a temp root and running pytest with an absolute test path (fixture 'root' not found) versus a relative path or explicit --rootdir (1 passed)
attempted_strategy: Ran the isolated subprocess with an explicit `--rootdir=<campaign-root>` so pytest treats the campaign root as rootdir and loads tests/conftest.py regardless of the argument path type.
result: With --rootdir set, all nine mutation sentinels are killed (killed=9, survive=0, infra=0, score=1.0, passed=true) and the harness proceeds past the mutation gate.
proposed_heuristic: When isolating a pytest subprocess into a temporary root, always pass the absolute campaign root via `--rootdir` (in addition to setting PYTHONPATH) so parent conftest.py fixtures are loaded; do not rely on relative-path rootdir inference that silently drops parent conftest files.
scope: process-only (scripts/mutation_smoke.py); no effect on normative tasks, ontologies, rubrics or scorers
contamination_risk: Minimal; applies only to the deterministic reproduction harness, not to benchmark measurement.

observation: After editing conductor/release-blockers.json or track metadata, three derived artifacts go stale together: conductor/status.md, conductor/tracks.md and .github/issues/manifest.json. The harness catches this only late (five test failures plus validate_repo), all tracing to a single stale-manifest root cause.
attempted_strategy: Regenerate both views and the issue manifest immediately after any metadata edit, before running the harness.
result: Harness passes end-to-end on the first attempt after regeneration (HARNESS_OK).
proposed_heuristic: Any edit under conductor/ requires running scripts/generate_conductor_docs.py and scripts/generate_issue_manifest.py before validation; treat them as codegen targets of the metadata, not hand-edited docs.
scope: process-only (Conductor registry maintenance); no effect on normative tasks, ontologies, rubrics or scorers

observation: src/pelicanbench/validation.py enforces blocker-level status == complete iff every closure criterion is complete (inconsistent-blocker-status error), so flipping the last criterion of RB-05 to complete forces the parent RB-05 status to flip in the same change set; partial edits leave the repo unvalidatable.
attempted_strategy: Flip criterion RB-05-C3 and parent status RB-05 atomically, then regenerate derived views.
result: validate_repo and release-readiness pass with RB-05 complete at evidence level E1.
proposed_heuristic: When closing a final blocker criterion, always update the parent blocker status in the same edit and treat generate_conductor_docs/generate_issue_manifest as mandatory follow-ups.
scope: process-only (Conductor registry semantics); no effect on normative tasks, ontologies, rubrics or scorers

observation: Under CPython 3.15.0a8, every Cython-compiled dependency tested (pyyaml 6.0.3 source build, hypothesis _native module, numpy/scipy/statsmodels wheel availability) fails with SystemError 'unknown slot ID' or has no cp315 wheel; pure-Python deps (pydantic via rust maturin build) compile fine. The blocker for a 3.15 reference environment is the compiled-ecosystem wheel gap, not removed stdlib features.
evidence: /tmp/install315*.log; /tmp/t315.log; /tmp/t315t.log; uv pip install under /tmp/venv315 and /tmp/venv315t (3.15.0a8 GIL and free-threaded)
attempted_strategy: Install full extras under 3.15a8; fall back to core+dev extras; run pytest collection in both GIL and free-threaded builds.
result: All attempts fail before test execution at import/collection of Cython extensions.
proposed_heuristic: Re-run this canary after each 3.15 beta/rc using only pure-Python plus abi3 wheels; promote the interpreter only when the full locked closure installs without source builds.
scope: process-only (interpreter upgrade planning); no effect on normative tasks, ontologies, rubrics or scorers
